claim.text: Offline benchmark record: accountability 100%, governed-agent 6 of 6, agent-recovery 6 of 6, provider swap 10 of 10, seal 107a33f920629afb.

control.description: Flip one committed per-task outcome in the paired-replication input; the seal must change.

covers: That the published numbers and seal follow from the code and committed inputs at a8e1cd2e. The seal hashes results, not timings.
does_not_cover: Whether the scenarios represent use. The maker wrote them; the suite's own non-goal says it measures accountability, not capability, and ranks Flywheel against no other harness.
notes: The externalization dimension runs pytest in a subprocess. Without pytest installed it scores 0 instead of reporting that it could not run, harness_overall drops to 0.875 and the seal changes (found by this manifest's first Linux CI run, 2026-10-04). The record does not name pytest as a requirement; this manifest does, and the runner refuses to start without it.
